notes: the four quiet bars the bounce opens on (-44dB). Played once at the start of a deal, then it hands to the main bed
THE MAIN BED — 24 bars from bar 4. Loops until ten cards are on the foundations
DEVELOPMENT — the 40-bar middle, 8dB down on `deal`. Takes over at ten cards
THE LOUDEST — the 16-bar loop the bounce states twice. Takes over at twenty-six cards, half the deck
the four-bar tail. Starts on the win, at the next bar, under the wash of whatever was playing, and holds until the next deal
